###  Sobre Servifund&mol Sl
La empresa informa que su actividad es fundición del aluminio. La sociedad está registrada como Sociedad Limitada. Su CNAE corresponde a 2445 con código 'Producción de otros metales no férreos'. La compañía es importadora y exportadora.  
  
Ha habido un descenso en cuanto al número de empleados y teniendo en cuenta la información disponible en INFORMA, ha dispuesto de un número de empleados por encima de la media de sector.  
  
Dentro del ranking de empresas elaborado por INFORMA, atendiendo a los niveles de facturación de la empresa, se destaca que: en 2024, en la clasificación del sector, la empresa se ha colocado 1 puesto más abajo y su posición actual es 9 (el año anterior estaba en 8). Antes de la compañía, en el ranking del sector, están empresas como: **Sociedad Iberica de Metales Nobles S.A** y **Recuperaciones Hnos Crespo Perucha S.L** ; sin embargo, por debajo se encuentran empresas como: **Ferroglobe Innovation S.L** y **Aleaciones de Elgoibar S.L**. En el ranking nacional, ha caído pasando de la posición 88.786 a 101.743, bajando 12.957 puestos. Aparecen mejor posicionadas las siguientes compañías: **Arista Group Management S.L** y **Chris Alcon Store, Sociedad Limitada** , sin embargo, entre las compañías que se colocan por detrás podemos encontrar: **Comercial Albaycin 2020 S.L** y **Indutal 97 S.L**. Ha retrocedido 1.923 puestos, pasando del 14.113 al 16.036 en el ranking provincial.  
  
Es posible ponerse en contacto con la empresa a través del teléfono 937598606 y el correo electrónico es administración@servifundmol.com. Puedes consultar su página web aquí: [www.servifundmol.com](https://www.servifundmol.com).  
  
La sociedad española **Servifund &mol S.L**, NIF B61746608, tiene domicilio fiscal en Calle Domenech I Montaner Pol Ind Sud núm. 1, (08191), en el municipio de Rubi, en Barcelona, Cataluña.  
  
Con los datos a disposición de INFORMA sobre 155 empresas pertenecientes al sector, la facturación en el ámbito nacional alcanza los 460 millones de euros y en 2024 la media de facturación de ventas entre todas las compañías alcanza los 2 millones de euros. Como información adicional de interés, la media de empleados es de 4; la antigüedad alcanza los 24 años desde la constitución.  
  
Para concluir, **Servifund &mol S.L** se emplea en fundición del aluminio. En cuanto a la posición en el ranking nacional, la empresa ha perdido posiciones frente al 2023.

# WER WIR SIND
### **Familienunternehmen seit 1998**
Herzlich willkommen bei SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L., einem Familienunternehmen mit Sitz in Rubí (Barcelona), das sich auf die Herstellung von Aluminiumgussteilen spezialisiert hat. Mit über 20 Jahren Erfahrung verwenden wir bei unserem Aluminiumguss die Schwerkraft- und Spritzgusstechniken.
Dank unserer vollständig flexiblen Struktur, unserer großen Produktionskapazität und unserer Anpassungsfähigkeit an spezifische Anforderungen haben wir uns als vielseitige Aluminiumgießerei mit hohen Qualitätsstandards zu wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen etabliert.
Wir bieten einen umfassenden Service an, bei dem wir den gesamten Prozess übernehmen, angefangen bei der Herstellung der erforderlichen Formen oder Kokillen bis hin zur Bearbeitung der Teile in allen erforderlichen Operationen.
Wir erzielen Oberflächen von hohem Anspruch, wie z. B. polierte oder verchromte Oberflächen, für Teile, die anspruchsvolle dekorative Beschichtungen erfordern.
Wir bedienen praktisch alle Branchen: Beleuchtung, Automobilindustrie, Eisenbahnindustrie, elektrische Geräte, Schlosserei, Elektronik, Industriemaschinenbau, Gastronomie, Eisenwaren usw. Wenn Sie eine Liste der Teile sehen möchten, besuchen Sie die Abschnitte Teiletypen und Branchen.
## UNSERE GESCHICHTE
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/timeline-2024-v2.png)
### 2024
Wir stellen auf der MetalMadrid, Composites y Robomática Madrid, Teil von Advanced Manufacturing Madrid, auf der IFEMA, Pavillon 7 und 9 aus.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/timeline-2024-1.png)
### 2024
Erweiterung unseres Maschinenparks. 
Installation einer neuen Aluminium-Spritzgießmaschine mit 250 Tonnen. 
Dies ermöglicht uns, unsere Fertigungskapazität zu erhöhen.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2019.png)
### 2019
Installation von Maschinen zur Herstellung von Formen, was uns die Vor-Ort-Herstellung von Schwerkraftformen ermöglicht. Dies ermöglicht uns, wettbewerbsfähigere Preise und besserem Service anzubieten.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2018.png)
### ISO 9001:2015
Anpassung an die neue Version der Norm ISO 9001, was zum Erhalt der Zertifizierung ISO 9001:2015 führte. 
Das Qualitätsmanagementsystem ist reifer und effektiver. Es ist ein strategischer Faktor in der Kultur von SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L. 
Wir sind stolz darauf, uns weiterzuentwickeln, um neuen Herausforderungen zu begegnen.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2016.png)
### ISO 9001:2008
Erhalt der Zertifizierung ISO 9001:2008, verliehen von der Spanischen Vereinigung für Normung und Zertifizierung, AENOR1. 
Diese Anerkennung zeigt die Fähigkeit von SERVIFUND&MOL, Produkte und Dienstleistungen bereitzustellen, die die Anforderungen unserer Kunden, gesetzliche und andere anwendbare Anforderungen erfüllen. Es war eine Anerkennung der Bemühungen, die in den vergangenen Jahren unternommen wurden.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2014.png)
### Neue Einrichtungen Rubí
Umzug in die aktuellen Einrichtungen in Rubí.
Die Produktionskapazität für Schwerkraft wurde erweitert und neue Maschinen für die Aluminiumspritzgussfertigung wurden integriert. Bald begannen wir, andere Unternehmen zu beliefern und etablierten uns in der heute hauptsächlichen Tätigkeit: der Aluminiumgussherstellung durch Schwerkraft und Spritzguss.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2009.png)
### Umzug Cabrera de Mar
Umzug in die Einrichtungen in Cabrera de Mar. 
Neue Maschinen und Ausrüstungen für die Schwerkraftgießung von Aluminiumlegierungen wurden integriert. In diesen Jahren wurde die Kunst der Kokillenguss-Aluminiumschmelze erworben und Erfahrungen gesammelt.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-1998.png)
### Beginn der Aktivität
Das Unternehmen wurde 1998 von der Familie Estrella de Haro gegründet, die über mehr als 40 Jahre Erfahrung in der Branche verfügte.
In seinen Anfängen wurde es konzipiert, um Aluminiumteile zu liefern, die immer unter hohen Qualitätsanforderungen standen. Die ersten Einrichtungen befanden sich in einer Werkstatt in Montmeló.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/1.3_ALMACEN.jpg)
## EINRICHTUNGEN
Wir befinden uns in Rubí, 20 km westlich von Barcelona, mit einer perfekten logistischen Lage und Nähe, um unsere Produkte sowohl in Spanien als auch in ganz Europa zu vertreiben.
Derzeit verfügen wir über Einrichtungen von 2.100 m2, aufgeteilt auf: Formenwerkstatt, Gießerei, Zweitoperationen, mechanische Werkstatt, Büros, Lager und Versand. Wir haben einen eigenen Transport.

# Quality
### SYSTEMS AND PROCESSES
Quality is fundamental and is a strategic factor in SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L.’s culture.
The satisfaction of our clients is the best guarantee of our leadership and development in our activity. To achieve this, it is necessary to know the real needs of our customers and to provide them with the appropriate services to satisfy their most demanding requirements.
At SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L. we have developed and implemented a Quality Management System based on the UNE-EN-ISO 9001:2015 reference standard, with the participation, involvement and collaboration of the entire team.
Our quality system is based on the following points:
  * Application of the UNE-EN-ISO 9001:2015 standard.
  * Self-control in manufacturing.
  * Quality Department equipped with the means to support manufacturing and the satisfaction of the customer’s needs.
  * Continuous improvement.

### QUALITY DEPARTMENT
The quality department is responsible for guaranteeing and controlling the quality of all our processes and products. All our products go through a meticulous system of checks, from the analysis of the raw material to the machine and end-of-batch checks, so that they can be accompanied by a quality certificate, ensuring that our product arrives at its destination with total guarantee and traceability.
**CONTROLS DURING THE PRODUCTION PROCESS**
  * Control of the reception of raw materials.
  * Continuous control of the melting temperature.
  * Monitoring of customer specifications by means of an internal technical sheet.
  * Final check on dispatch of parts.


**CONTROLS ON FINISHED PARTS**
  * Control of chemical composition, with optical emission spectrometer by spark discharges.
  * Dimensional control with multiple measuring equipment: height gauges, calipers, caliper gauges, radius gauges, etc.
  * We have also been working closely for many years with external laboratories to carry out metallographic tests, work tests, mechanical tests, X-ray tests, liquid penetrant tests, etc.


Among the tests carried out, we highlight the following:
  * Spectrometer (analysis of chemical composition)
  * Durometer (hardness analysis of raw material and product)
  * Dimensional control


We have a calibration programme for all our equipment, guaranteed by an application calendar together with the corresponding register.

## ALUMINIUM ALLOYS
We know that each project is unique and requires a specific alloy to obtain optimum results. To achieve this, we have a wide range of aluminium alloys that give you the freedom to make the best choices for your product.
Aluminium alloy characteristics:
  * High operating temperatures
  * Exceptional corrosion resistance
  * Light weight
  * Very good strength and toughness
  * Good stiffness and strength-to-weight ratio
  * Heat dissipative properties
  * Excellent thermal conductivity
  * High electrical conductivity
  * Excellent shielding properties against Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) and Radio Frequency Interference (RFI)
  * Good finishing characteristics
  * Full recyclability


We work with aluminium alloys based on the UNE-EN 1706 Standard, all our material is of high quality from approved suppliers of the best quality at national level.

# **ENVIRONMENT**
###### Management commitment
At SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L. we respect the environment, and therefore comply with the current regulations on waste disposal, emissions and noise control required by the authorities.
The management is fully committed to maintaining the reliability and quality of its products and services, as well as respecting the environment. To this end, it undertakes to comply with legal, regulatory and contractual requirements, as well as other requirements to which the organisation subscribes related to its environmental aspects, and to adopt the necessary measures to avoid or minimise the negative environmental impacts that may be generated by the activity.
**We actively protect the environment:** :
  * In the smelting process, secondary aluminium is used and thus forms part of the closed recycling cycle of the raw material aluminium. We recycle aluminium scrap and turn it into new products through smelting.
  * We have a system in place to reuse the aluminium scrap produced in the smelting and machining process, either for the smelting of new parts or for scrap.


![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/ENVIRONMENT.jpg)
**Environmental Commitment**
At SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L., our aluminum casting activity is guided by a strong commitment to sustainability. We believe in a cleaner, more Efficient industry aligned with the challenges of climate change. Therefore, all our operations follow principles of environmental respect, circular economy, and continuous improvement.
**Core Environmental Principles**
– Strict legal compliance: Ensuring every process meets current environmental regulations.  
– Impact prevention and control: Minimizing risks at every stage of production.  
– Sustainable innovation: Promoting energy efficiency and good environmental practices across all company areas.
**Circular Economy and Recycled Aluminum Use**
Over 90% of our parts are made from recycled aluminum, reducing CO₂ emissions by 85% compared to primary aluminum. Additionally, more than 75% of production scraps are reused internally.
**Responsible Resource Management**
– Energy optimization through efficient furnace and machinery maintenance.  
– Water reduction using recirculation systems and improved cooling processes.
**Sustainable Packaging**
– Elimination of non-recyclable plastics.  
– Over 80% of packaging comes from recycled or reusable materials.  
– Use of returnable and low-impact packaging solutions with suppliers.
**Hazardous Waste Management**
All hazardous waste (used oil, contaminated containers, absorbents) is securely handled and legally managed by authorized entities.
**Training and Environmental Culture**
– Annual internal environmental controls.  
– Ongoing staff training.  
– Integrated environmental emergency plans.
**Community and Local Suppliers**
We prioritize local suppliers within 100 km who meet our social and environmental standards. This reduces our carbon footprint and supports the local economy.
Every action matters. At SERVIFUND&MOL, we work daily for a more sustainable future.

# WHO WE ARE
### **Family business since 1998**
Welcome to SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L., a family business located in Rubí (Barcelona), dedicated to the manufacture of aluminium alloy castings. After more than 20 years of experience, our aluminium foundry incorporates the techniques of gravity casting and die casting.
Thanks to our totally flexible structure, our high production capacity and our ability to adapt to specific needs, we have established ourselves as a versatile aluminium foundry with high quality standards at the most competitive prices.
We offer a complete service, in which we take responsibility for the entire process, from the manufacture of the moulds or shells that are necessary, as well as the finishing of parts in all the operations requested.
We obtain highly demanding surface finishes, such as polished or chrome finishes, for those parts destined for demanding decorative coatings.
We cover practically all sectors: lighting, automotive, railway industry, electrical equipment, locksmithery, electronics, industrial machinery, catering, ironmongery, etc. If you wish to see a list of parts, please visit the sections types of parts and sectors.

## ENGINEERING
We provide technical support and follow-up services for any proposal presented to us, studying its viability. After understanding our customers’ wishes and how our capabilities can help, we work together to develop moulding designs that meet their requirements for functionality and castability.
Our library includes different 2D and 3D software both internally and externally.
Our staff has been confronted with different problems and this has allowed us to acquire a know-how, which allows us to guarantee the requirements of our customers. In this first phase of the production process, we try to take great care of the quality of the design, as well as verifying the raw materials used.
## MOULD MANUFACTURING
We have a technical office equipped with 2D and 3D design programmes for developing projects for parts, moulds, dies and special machines. The programmes are connected to CNC machines.
Our workshop is equipped with CNC milling machines, lathes and die sinking EDM, which allows us to build moulds, dies, tooling and tools for the industrialisation of the product, according to the customer’s specifications.
We also have strategic suppliers located within a radius of less than 50 km from our plant for the construction of injection moulds.
This allows us to work together to determine the location of the core, the layout of the overflow and the design of the filling channels.
In this way, we want to provide the customer with all the stages involved in the casting of aluminium parts, an added value that we provide through a flexible and comprehensive service that will reduce costs and delivery times.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/MOLDE-Y-MECANIZADO.jpg)
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/3.1_GRAVEDAD.jpg)
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/3.1_GRAVEDAD_2.jpg)
## GRAVITY DIE CASTING
We specialise in gravity or permanent mould gravity casting. The casting of molten metal into a mould and its solidification under its own weight, hence the name “gravity casting”, is one of the most common casting techniques. It makes it possible to produce short or long series of parts with optimum quality and short set-up times.
We have the know-how to manufacture parts with sand cores, which, once inserted into the mould, allow us to obtain hollow parts or complex internal geometries.
We specialise in manufacturing with alloys with high mechanical requirements, such as EN AC-42000 and EN AC-42200 alloys.
Main benefits:
  * Allows us to produce short series
  * Optimum quality
  * Parts with high mechanical requirements
  * Parts with complex internal geometries
  * Long mould life, with production runs of more than 50,000 units
  * Fast mould making
  * Parts that require subsequent heat treatment


Our human team and production means allow us to always manufacture the parts in their optimum machine, depending on the weight, dimensions and number of cavities, in the most competitive way.
We have the following production means for gravity die casting:
  * Conventional crucible gas furnaces (300 to 600 kg).
  * Horizontal automatic hydraulic machines
  * Semi-automatic 4-cylinder hydraulic machines
  * Manual 4-cylinder machines


## INJECTION MOULDING
Cold chamber die casting is ideal for metals such as aluminium, which have a high melting point. During this process, the metal is melted in a furnace at extremely high temperatures and then dosed into a cold chamber to be injected into the mould.
Die casting or injection moulding are based on the possibility of producing large batches of products in short times and at a low cost.
Main benefits:
  * Variable wall thickness
  * Tighter tolerances
  * Fast production cycle times
  * Fewer production steps on finished part
  * Reduction of waste material


We have the following production means for injection moulding:
  * High pressure die casting machines (150-500 Tn).
  * Automatic feeding system
  * Die-casting presses (10-20 Tn)
  * Auxiliary equipment: mould tempering machines, etc.


![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/3.2_INYECCION.jpg)
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/3.2_INYECCION_2.jpg)
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/4.3_SIERRA.jpg)
## SECOND OPERATIONS
We have specific areas for the sawing of casting channels and cores. The aim is to remove all foreign elements from the part until a suitable rough finish is obtained in accordance with our customers’ requirements.
We have the following production means for the manual cutting and sanding section:
  * Endless saws
  * Double polishing machines
  * Planing machines
  * Eccentric presses


## MECHANICAL WORKSHOP
We have an exclusive section for the maintenance of moulds and dies.
To carry out simple machining operations, we have the following production resources: CNC machining centres, Electro-erosion machine, conventional lathes and milling machines, planing machines, welding, etc.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/4.4_TALLER.jpg)
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/4.5_MONTAGES_2.jpg)
## FINISHING AND ASSEMBLY
Today more than ever, innovative and advanced customers are looking for a complete supplier, offering a unique supply. To respond to this need, SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L. provides a wide range of services, including simple machining operations and all types of assemblies.
We also collaborate with highly qualified approved suppliers who supply us with all types of complementary finishes to the casting, or with a combination of several of them.
